reason: I've had bleeding after sex and irregular periods.
diagnosis: Likely cervical cancer or a significant cervical lesion causing postcoital bleeding and abnormal vaginal bleeding, given the history of bleeding after intercourse, irregular periods, and likely cervical symptoms discussed in the consultation.
keyPoints: Characterise the bleeding: postcoital, intermenstrual, heavy or spotting
Assess associated symptoms: pelvic pain, discharge, weight loss, fatigue
Gynaecological history: last menstrual period, cycle regularity, contraception, pregnancy risk
Cervical screening history and HPV vaccination status
Sexual history and STI risk, including new partners and condom use
Red flags for cervical malignancy: persistent foul discharge, dyspareunia, unexplained weight loss
Past gynae history and examination findings, especially any cervical abnormalities
